scope.purpose: Design-only review of the selected SearchPanel contributions and their consistency with adopted intent.

reviewed_contributions.commitment: Show the user's current search results.
Publish matching records for the active request.

commitments: Only the active request may publish results.
Cancelling a request immediately makes it inactive.

reviewed_contributions.commitment: A cancelled request completes after its replacement starts; the cancelled request must not publish its results.

relationships_assessed: The publication and cancellation constraints preserve the adopted intent at intent.md:1-3.
The interface publication promise is compatible with the active-request invariant.
The cancelled-request case agrees with both constraints: immediate inactivity excludes publication after cancellation, including completion after a replacement starts.
SearchPanel owns all selected contributions. The captured draft contains no imports, Tags, Inline Links, or additional owners requiring contextual resolution.
The compact design supplies the required Goal and Interface content. No consequential missing obligation or material simplification was established.
omitted_scope: Components outside the selected SearchPanel contribution

limitations: Assessment is bound to the verified captured bytes and the request's original-to-captured mapping; current original workspace bytes were not inspected.
Read-only restrictions were instructions only; the host technically permitted writes. No files were written or modified.

No network, compiler, implementation inspection, or execution tests were used. This completed design-only assessment does not establish compiler validation, implementation conformance, or saturated coherence.
